name: Kannagi Kino
source:
A first-year student at Masumi Private Girls' Academy.

Her parents are famous magicians, and she lives almost alone because they travel all over the world.

She wants to become a magician herself someday, so she invited Shizuka and Fuyuko to start a "Magic Club."
Although she is the youngest in the club, she is the best at magic tricks and has become Shizuka's mentor.

She is a cheerful, playful girl with good communication skills. She is proactive and her motto is "When I think of something, I act on it right away."

She likes to play pranks, and often gets scolded for playing pranks on Fuyuko together with Shizuka.

She is quite skillful, and makes most of her own magic tools.
She also thinks up illusion tricks and writes them down in a notebook.

Since she spends a lot of time alone, she often stays at the Otobe house.
She always carries playing cards and magic coins with her.
